name: merge_vertical_extents_and_blit
description: Copies the first rectangle's origin, merges the vertical extents of the two rectangles, and writes the blitter register sequence for the merged area. key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:2BAA

description: Sets the output's top from the first rectangle's top adjusted by the difference of the bottoms, keeps the second rectangle's bottom, and writes the blitter register sequence for the result. A second blit for the second rectangle follows when it is non-empty.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:2C50
name: blit_rows_of_second_rectangle

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:2C6A

name: call_helpers_passing_argument

name: reset_record_fields_after_calls

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:3200

description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The facts show a 153-instruction routine entered by direct call from two unnamed routines, which itself calls three unnamed routines; its purpose cannot be recovered from this evidence.

name: blit_image_into_four_planes

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:4560

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:46FA
name: read_menu_selection_value
description: Clears the current menu highlight and returns the value stored for the highlighted entry, but only when that entry is enabled; otherwise it returns zero. It then calls a routine to redraw the menu at a fixed position.

name: draw_menu_entry_state
description: Stores the string descriptor for a menu entry and calls the draw routine with a mode byte of zero or twenty-five, depending on the second argument, using the entry's stored horizontal position.

name: update_menu_hover_selection
description: Maps a pointer position to a menu row by comparing its horizontal position with a table of column edges. key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:4914
name: format_padded_menu_label
description: Copies a menu entry's text into a local buffer, pads it with spaces to a width derived from the row count, and draws it using a mode byte chosen by whether the entry is enabled and highlighted.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:49F8
name: alternate_selection_frame_pointer
description: While a selection is active, flips a zero-or-one index, sets the active pointer from a two-entry table and calls the draw routine. On every second call it also calls a routine that returns a word, masks it to two bits and passes the result on to a second routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:4B1A

name: fill_region_in_strips

name: forward_to_single_routine

name: store_channel_flag_index

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:611A
name: append_node_to_list
description: Appends a node to the end of a singly linked list whose head is stored at a fixed address, clears the node's next link, and returns the original head.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6134
name: append_node_at_tail
description: Walks from a starting node to the last node of a list and links the new node after it, clearing the new node's link. It is the register-argument form of the list append routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6140
name: link_node_after_node
description: Stores a new node in the link field of the given node and clears the new node's own link field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6150
name: unlink_node_then_process
description: Walks a list from a fixed head address until it finds the given node, replaces the link pointing to it with that node's own link, and then passes the node to a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6186
name: update_list_nodes_by_type
description: Walks the active node list and passes each node to a handler chosen by its type code from eight handlers. When a handler reports completion it clears the channel's flag, passes the node on to a routine and removes it; it returns one when the list is empty and zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6290
name: advance_node_animation_frame
description: On the first call it counts the entries of a table up to a terminator word and stores the count, then sets the node's sprite fields and calls routines to draw the frame. On later calls it moves to the next frame and returns zero, or returns one once the sequence is complete.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:62B2
name: advance_node_frame_sequence
description: Counts the frames of a terminated table on the first call and stores the count, then selects the first frame and calls routines to draw it. On later calls it steps to the next frame, calls routines to draw it, and returns zero until the sequence is complete.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:62E0
name: count_frames_and_start
description: Counts the entries of a frame table up to its terminator word and stores the count. It then selects the first frame's position, calls a routine to start the animation, and clears a node field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6306
name: start_fixed_length_animation
description: Sets the node's frame count to a fixed value of eight, selects the first frame's position from the frame table, calls a routine to start the animation, and clears a node field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6326
name: start_first_frame_only
description: Selects the first frame's position from the frame table without counting entries, calls a routine to start it, and clears a node field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:638E
name: step_frame_until_complete
description: While the frame index is below the frame count, it fetches the next frame position, advances the index and calls routines to draw the frame, returning zero. Otherwise it stores the final frame's position and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:63C8
name: step_frame_and_redraw
description: Passes the current frame's position to routines, advances the frame index and draws the frame, then clears a node field when the node is not in its special mode. It returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:648E
name: mark_node_done_flag
description: Sets a node field to one, stores the saved pointer back into its slot, and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6712
name: select_record_and_verify
description: Builds a table of 72 text pointers, picks a record from an embedded text block using a random-number routine, and copies its name up to a comma. It formats a count with a fixed suffix and draws it under the heading text 'Quartex 1988:', then compares the name with a second text case-insensitively and counts a mismatch when they differ.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6A04
name: advance_frame_with_counter
description: Frame-step variant of its neighbours: on the first call it counts frames up to a terminator word and stores the count, otherwise it steps to the next frame. The listing begins with a write through an address derived from bad data, which is an artefact and not behaviour.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6A34
name: advance_frame_and_report_done
description: Advances a node's frame sequence: on the first call it counts the frames and starts the first one, otherwise it steps to the next frame and draws it. It returns true only when the sequence has reached its last frame.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6A68
name: start_counted_frame_sequence
description: Counts a terminated frame table, stores the count, and starts the first frame by calling drawing routines. It returns true only when the sequence has a single frame.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6A82
name: start_fixed_frame_sequence
description: Starts a frame sequence whose length is supplied in a register: it stores the count, selects the first frame and draws it. It returns true when the count is one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6B0A
name: draw_frame_then_advance
description: Draws the current frame from a table, advances the frame index and sets a node flag to one. It returns true when the index reaches the frame count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6BA6
name: store_frame_cursor_zero
description: Stores the saved frame cursor back into its slot and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6BB0
name: advance_frame_with_delay
description: While its countdown byte is zero it resets the countdown, draws either the first frame or the next frame, sets a mode flag and advances the frame pointer, returning one when the terminator is reached. While the countdown is nonzero it decrements it and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6BD0
name: draw_frame_and_advance_cursor
description: Draws the first frame when the cursor is empty, otherwise draws the next frame, sets the node flag, and advances the cursor. It returns true when the next entry is the table terminator.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6C30
name: draw_next_frame_and_advance
description: Draws the next frame from a table with routines, sets a node flag to one and advances the cursor. It returns true when the next entry is the table terminator.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:6C90
name: store_cursor_and_return_zero
description: Stores the saved cursor back into its slot and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:71CC
name: advance_timed_text_script
description: While its countdown byte is zero it runs high-bit command bytes from a script through a routine, then reads the next plain byte as the new countdown and returns one. While the countdown is nonzero it decrements it and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:71E8
name: run_text_script_commands
description: Runs high-bit command bytes from a script by calling a routine with a table entry and a value derived from the next byte, then reads the next plain byte as the countdown. It returns one and does not decrement the countdown.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7246
name: read_next_countdown_byte
description: Reads the next byte of a script into the countdown field, or sets the countdown to zero when the script reaches its terminator, and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:725A
name: read_countdown_byte_unchecked
description: Reads the next byte of a script into the countdown field without checking for the terminator, and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7268
name: clear_countdown_return_one
description: Clears a countdown byte and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7272
name: redraw_grid_cell_pair
description: Converts a record's coordinates into grid-cell indices and redraws the cell's occupant through indirect routines, clearing that cell's flag afterwards. When the record's flag is set it first replaces the record with a derived one, with different offsets for type six; for type six it also clears a second cell.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:72DA
name: redraw_fixed_grid_cell
description: Builds a type-three record from fixed coordinates and redraws the matching grid cell through indirect routines, clearing its flag. When a stored flag is set and the record type is six, it also clears a second cell.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7604
name: query_grid_cell_flag
description: Converts a coordinate into a grid-cell index, then calls a routine with that index and the cell's flag bit of value 64.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7660
name: store_grid_cell_record
description: Packs a record's kind and flags, together with a type code chosen from the kind and position, into the grid-cell table. It stores a second field and an index in the entry table, then calls a routine with the cell's table entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:774E
name: clear_table_and_init_timer
description: Clears a 512-entry table of four-byte words, fetches a ten-byte value through a library routine, and stores a derived word chosen by a global flag. It calls two routines and adds the difference between a returned value and a saved value to a counter.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:77D2
name: check_flag_and_store
description: If the zero flag is set it calls three routines and returns the result halved. Otherwise it calls a routine and stores its result and a second register value into a table indexed by a register value, then returns the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:77FC
name: adjust_counter_on_match
description: Returns its inputs unchanged unless the low bit of a flag is set and two positions are equal. In that case it adds the difference between one position and a stored value to a counter and calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:783E
name: assemble_byte_from_calls
description: Repeats eight times: shifts an accumulator left, calls a routine, and sets the accumulator's low bit when the shifted value is nonzero. The eight calls build one byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7852
name: build_huffman_table
description: Reads 256 length-and-value word pairs and fills a local decoding table: codes up to eight bits are placed directly, while longer codes go into a second-level list. The finished table is then copied into the shared 512-entry table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7922
name: decode_huffman_symbols
description: Decodes up to a requested number of symbols from a bit stream using the shared table, writing each decoded byte to the output pointer. Codes of eight bits or fewer are looked up directly and longer ones through the second-level list; the bit position is saved for the next call and the count decoded is returned.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7A3A
name: empty_stub_routine
description: Contains only a return and does nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7A4C
name: fetch_bit_stream_word
description: Returns a 32-bit bit-stream window built from the next 16-bit source word. When a flag is set it reads the word directly; otherwise it adds the elapsed counter difference to a timer, calls a routine, and reads the word through an indirect pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7A94
name: decode_huffman_into_buffer
description: Decodes symbols from the bit stream into an output buffer using the shared table until the requested count is reached, then stores the final output pointer. The listing uses flattened control flow, and at the end it appends a zero byte when a parity check on the block length succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7BD8
name: start_bit_stream_read
description: Resets the bit-stream state and calls a routine, then loads a byte from the source pointer, or a word when that pointer is at an odd address. It sets the bit mask by shifting a constant by the argument and advances a counter.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7C1A
name: adjust_counter_by_pointer_gap
description: Adds the gap between two stored pointers, with a fixed 512-byte margin and minus an argument word, to a counter, then calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7C34
name: initialise_buffer_and_clear_flag
description: Passes a buffer and a fixed flag value to a library routine, calls three routines, then clears a word field. The meaning of the flag value is not recovered from the listing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7C5A
name: dispatch_state_handler
description: Calls a routine, then dispatches on a stored state word: states zero and one each call a routine, state two calls a further routine, and any other state returns the state minus two without a call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7C8C
name: initialise_two_state_flags
description: Calls two routines, sets two state words to one, and calls a routine. When a flag is clear it runs two further routines, then calls a final routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7CCE
name: rotate_history_table_entries
description: Copies eight-byte records within a 105-slot table in mirrored order, resets the index to minus one, and copies two stored longs into the first slot and a second location.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7D3C
name: shift_history_table_down
description: Decrements an index, shifts the 105-slot table of eight-byte records one place toward the start, then writes two stored longs into the first slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7D96
name: reset_playback_state_fields
description: Clears several state words and sets one to 200 when a flag is set. It calls a library routine with a buffer and a fixed flag value, maps a table entry of zero, one or two to a stored state, and then calls a final routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7E28
name: run_eight_step_sequence
description: Calls one routine, then four routines in each of eight iterations, calls one more routine, and resets two state words to zero and one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7EBA
name: reset_history_index_and_copy
description: Sets a history index to minus one and copies two stored longs into a fixed slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7ED4
name: store_byte_pair_by_index
description: Stores the two low bytes of its first argument into a four-byte-stride table, at the position given by the low word of the second argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7F00
name: run_timed_playback_loop
description: Clears two counters; when a selection test passes it reads a value from a table at the history index, sets a busy flag, and polls routines for a timer and an event until the event returns a nonzero value, then clears the flag and sets the state to one. Otherwise it calls one routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7F96
name: dispatch_playback_command
description: Dispatches on a command byte across nine case values, calling routines and setting state words in each. Two cases choose between a stored history entry and its neighbour, one shifts the history and fetches the next entry, and the default case clears the command word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:7FAC
name: clear_command_and_call
description: Calls a routine, runs a second routine, clears the command word, and calls a final routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:81DC
name: run_state_until_idle
description: Repeats a dispatch on a state index, where zero and one each call a routine and two calls another, for as long as the state is two and a table entry for the current index is one. It then clears the state and returns the last result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:8230
name: prepare_next_step_state
description: Resets two state words, then either resets the step state when a counter is zero or negative, or sets a busy flag, calls routines and polls a timer routine when the two step indices match. It ends by setting the history index to minus one and the step index to one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:82DE
name: check_end_condition_messages
description: Refreshes state values and, when a termination flag is set, plays one of two messages chosen by a side index, the texts 'Blue resigns' and 'Red resigns', then calls routines to finish. Otherwise it sets the step state to two and runs its routines, depending on the counters and the matched indices.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:84C4
name: empty_stub_routine
description: Contains only a return and does nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:84CC
name: empty_stub_routine
description: Contains only a return and does nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:84D4
name: sample_random_step_counts
description: Reads a random-number routine's result and selects a count from a table by its low four bits, then calls a routine that many times. It reads a second value masked to six bits and calls a routine that many times, copies two stored longs into two slots and clears three state words.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:857E
name: drain_queued_entries
description: Sets a busy flag, then when a counter is below a limit it calls a routine for each queued entry whose flag is set, handles the entry after the current one when its flag is one, and drains the rest. It then sets the wait count from the counter, or to 200, and clears the busy flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:865A
name: poll_until_result_matches
description: Increments a counter; when the index is below another it sets a flag. Otherwise it resets a counter and polls a routine until a flag clears or its returned value stops matching, and when a masked value equals the counter plus sixty-four it calls routines for two queued entries.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:874A
name: scan_balanced_entries
description: When a read value is below a threshold, it reads entries and counts flagged and unflagged ones until the balance returns to zero, then checks a further value and returns it or a routine's result. Otherwise it returns a routine's result directly.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:87BA
name: wait_until_status_bit_set
description: Polls a routine's result, calling a second routine between polls, until bit sixty-four of the result is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:87DA
name: drain_balance_counter
description: Decrements a counter and reads two values in a loop, adding to a balance for one flag and subtracting for another, until the balance returns to zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:8818
name: empty_stub_routine
description: Contains only a return and does nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:8820
name: record_timer_start
description: Reads the timer through a library routine with an argument of zero and stores the reading in two timer slots.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:8838
name: record_elapsed_timer_ticks
description: Reads the timer through a library routine and stores the reading, then stores the difference from the earlier reading in a second slot as the elapsed value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:8858
name: accumulate_elapsed_by_index
description: Calls a routine, then adds the stored elapsed value to an accumulator selected by the low word of its argument, using a four-byte stride.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:8876
name: forward_two_parameters
description: Passes its two arguments unchanged to another routine and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:888E
name: record_move_into_history
description: Writes two stored longs into the history slot after the current index, copies them into two state slots, and calls a routine with the slot's values.

name: advance_index_and_swap_pair

name: undo_index_swap_and_step

name: empty_stub_routine

name: set_delay_for_state
description: Stores the command's high byte as the state and sets a delay from it: state zero gives six, state ten calls two routines, and any other state gives five shifted left by the state minus one. It also clears two counters.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:8CEE
name: resume_delay_state
description: When the state is ten it calls two routines: a zero result restores the state saved on the stack, otherwise the result becomes the delay. For other states it sets the delay to five shifted left by the state minus one and clears two counters.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:8D0E
name: restore_state_from_stack
description: Copies a word saved in the caller's stack frame into the state word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:8D16
name: set_delay_from_state
description: Sets the delay to five shifted left by the state minus one, then clears two counters.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:8D32
name: start_delay_with_minimum
description: Sets one flag to one and another to zero, copies the delay into the timer, and raises the timer to at least three.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:8D5C
name: copy_byte_array
description: Copies a byte sequence from the source pointer to the destination pointer for a count given in the low word of the third argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:8D84
name: compare_byte_strings
description: Compares two byte sequences up to a count and returns zero when they match over that length. Otherwise it returns the difference between the first pair of mismatched bytes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:8DC4
name: refresh_display_markers
description: Blanks every text field in the registered text lists to spaces, sets a group of display flags, and places a plus-sign marker in the text fields that match the current state values. It also copies the counters into option entries, so the routine redraws the status text.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:8F9E
name: mark_bitmap_for_matches
description: Passes a buffer and a constant to a library routine, increments the history index and stores a pair of longs. It then loops over a routine's results and sets a bit in a bitmap for each entry whose returned value is zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:901C
name: wait_for_position_then_record
description: Clears a flag, increments the history index and calls a routine in a loop until the stored position matches the current one or the busy flag clears. It then writes the stored pair into the history slot, decrements the index and returns the flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9052
name: wait_for_position_change
description: While a busy flag is set it calls a routine until the position changes, then stores the new position. It then writes the stored pair into the history slot, decrements the index and returns the flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9082
name: pack_state_nibbles
description: Writes a header byte from a state field, then for eight groups of four table entries it packs each pair of entries into one output byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9132
name: set_side_and_reset_board
description: Stores the side from its byte argument and the opposite side, then runs thirty-two positions, calling two routines for each. It finishes by calling three routines and two more.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:91F0
name: check_piece_count_limits
description: Counts each side's pieces across the 120-cell table and returns a message pointer when a side has more than sixteen pieces or the king counts exceed their limit. Otherwise, when both sides have pieces, it checks the piece pair against eight stored offsets and calls routines; the message text cited is 'Red has too many pieces.'

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9290
name: check_stacked_piece_limit
description: Uses the piece counts left on the stack by the counting routine to test the same limits from the other side, returning a message pointer when a count is over its limit. The message text cited is 'Blue has too many pieces.'

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:92A0
name: check_red_king_limit
description: Uses the stacked counts to test the king limit of two: when a count is below the limit it returns a message pointer, and when both sides have at least one piece it scans eight stored offsets and calls routines. The message text cited is 'Red has too many Kings.'

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:92B0
name: check_blue_king_limit
description: Uses the stacked counts to test the king limit of two: when a count is below the limit it returns a message pointer, and when both sides have at least one piece it scans eight stored offsets and calls routines. The message text cited is 'Blue has too many Kings.'

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:92C0
name: check_red_king_needed
description: Returns a message pointer when either stacked count is below one; the text cited is 'Red needs a King.'. Otherwise it scans eight stored offsets from the current square, returns a message pointer on a match, and when there is no match calls routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:92D0
name: check_blue_king_needed
description: Returns a message pointer when the stacked count is below one; the text cited is 'Blue needs a King.'. Otherwise it scans eight stored offsets from the current square, returns a message pointer on a match, and when there is no match calls routines.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:92E0
name: check_kings_adjacent
description: Scans eight stored offsets from one king's square and returns a message pointer when the other king's square is among them; the text cited is 'Kings are adjacent.'. Otherwise it calls routines and returns a null or message pointer by their result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:931C
name: check_blue_in_check
description: Scans eight stored offsets from the current square for a match, calling routines when none is found and returning a message pointer by their result; the text cited is 'Blue is in Check.'.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:935E
name: return_red_check_message
description: Returns a message pointer without any computation; the text cited is 'Red is in Check.'.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9368
name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero without any other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:942E
name: reset_word_after_two_calls
description: Calls two routines and clears a state word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9442
name: return_minimum_value
description: Returns the smaller of the two 16-bit halves of its 32-bit argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:945E
name: return_maximum_value
description: Returns the larger of the two 16-bit halves of its 32-bit argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:947A
name: compute_absolute_value
description: Negates the low 16-bit half of its argument when that value is zero or negative and returns the result; positive values are returned unchanged.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9494
name: any_side_has_move
description: Steps the side index forward, calls routines, restores the index, then scans flagged candidate entries. It returns one when a candidate passes the routine's test and zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:94D8
name: show_game_end_message
description: Shows one of two end-of-game messages, 'Check and mate...Game over.' or 'Stalemate. How boring!!', according to a test routine's result. When the test passes it swaps the side indices, restores a stored pair and shows the second message.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:959C
name: search_candidate_move_target
description: Saves the previous square pair, sets the current candidate square from the active side's table, and scans the candidate's entries with a routine when a flag is set, recording the first match as a pending target. Otherwise it clears the saved square pair.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:969E
name: unpack_state_record
description: Reads a two-byte packed record from a table at the index given in the argument. The first byte is passed to a routine, and the second is unpacked into two two-bit fields and three flags stored in state words.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9746
name: pack_state_record
description: Writes a two-byte record: the first byte is a stored value, and the second packs three flags and two two-bit fields. It is the inverse of the unpacking routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:97AA
name: start_pending_target_action
description: When a pending target is set and the state is neither one nor six, it sets the state to six, clears the target, and calls a routine with the saved square pair, storing any nonzero result. It returns one when it acted and zero otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9808
name: emit_pending_state_bytes
description: When the active side's state is two, it calls two routines, then calls routines with the current state byte and the saved word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9860
name: read_byte_from_table
description: Calls a routine with the table address for the argument's low word, reads one byte through a second routine and returns it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9898
name: check_pair_result_zero
description: Calls a routine with its two arguments and returns true when that routine's result is zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:98BE
name: call_routine_with_fixed_buffer
description: Calls a library routine with the address of a fixed buffer and a zero argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:98D6
name: initialise_square_tables
description: Sets the first 120 four-byte table entries to sixteen, clears a two-by-sixteen byte grid, sets two words to minus one, and calls a routine with them.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:995A
name: index_squares_by_code
description: Walks a 16-column board layout, skipping off-board squares, and for each square whose code matches the current code from one to six records the square in a list for that code and counts it. When code six is reached it calls a routine with the list.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9A9A
name: inspect_unrecovered_routine_b
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The facts show a 24-instruction routine called directly by two unnamed routines and nothing else, so its purpose cannot be recovered from this evidence.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9AE2
name: swap_index_entries_and_store
description: Swaps two four-byte table entries chosen by the two low words of its argument, then stores the argument's second byte in a grid cell indexed by the swapped entries.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9B6C
name: clear_index_entry_cell
description: Clears the type byte of an indexed four-byte table entry and the grid cell that entry points to.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9BB6
name: store_index_entry_and_cell
description: Stores a code byte and an index byte in a four-byte table entry chosen by an argument, then writes the code byte into the grid cell that the entry points to and a second byte beside it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9C1C
name: update_index_minimum_and_store
description: Stores a code byte in a table entry and in the grid cell it points to, then replaces the stored value for that code with the entry's value when the stored value is smaller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9CC2
name: emit_candidate_square
description: Sends square values to output routines according to its flag arguments: the first or second position field, or a pair of values. For code six it combines two position fields into one value, and for other codes it tests a flag before emitting.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9DD0
name: build_step_offset_table
description: Clears a table and fills it with entries for a grid of step offsets: for each of eight rows and seven steps it writes two words at an offset computed from the row value and the step, using stored step values chosen by the row.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9EE2
name: test_step_reaches_target
description: Tests whether a code's step can reach the target square: code six defers to a routine, codes one and five succeed when the step mask matches, and other codes scan along the step until they reach the target or meet an occupied square. It returns whether the target was reached.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:9FC4
name: check_adjacent_code_six
description: Checks the two squares one row away in either direction from a position, offset by a step value, and returns one when either holds code six for the given argument. Otherwise it returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:A062
name: any_listed_entry_matches
description: Returns one at once when the routine on the first argument succeeds. Otherwise it walks the stored entries for that code from last to first and returns one if the routine succeeds for any entry, and zero if none does.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:A108
name: inspect_unrecovered_routine_c
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available. The facts show a 36-instruction routine called by two unnamed routines and calling one unnamed routine, so its purpose cannot be recovered from this evidence.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:A178
name: find_listed_position
description: Returns zero when the entry does not match the stored values. On a match it walks a saved list and returns a value derived from the list index of the first saved entry equal to the argument, or one when no such entry exists.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a].adf:BattleChess:0:A20E
name: check_entry_state_flags
description: Returns true when a short field at offset 4 is zero, a byte at offset 7 is zero, and the byte at offset 6 is nonzero and not six.
